candidates.exact_span:
The description, including procedures followed, and results of the Paint Filter Tests
          performed.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether this passage imposes a monitoring/documentation obligation for Paint Filter Tests (and whether results must be retained or reported) affects which monitoring requirements are applicable under Purpose B; if results are absent from the evidence, different readings of what must be documented versus merely performed change how missing-evidence cases are classified under Purpose C.

candidates.exact_span: The description, including procedures followed, and results of the TCLP Test.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Interpretation of whether a separate TCLP monitoring/documentation duty exists here (distinct from the later annual DMR reporting item) affects Purpose B applicability rows; ambiguity over required artifacts when no result is present affects Purpose C classification of missing TCLP evidence.

candidates.exact_span: The permittee shall report annually on the Discharge Monitoring Report the following information:
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether this establishes an annual DMR reporting obligation (versus optional or informational submission) and which monitoring period it binds affects which monitoring requirements are treated as required for Federal FY2025 under Purpose B.

candidates.exact_span:
Results of the Toxicity Characteristic Leaching Procedure Test conducted on the sludge to be
          disposed (Pass/Fail).
candidates.computation_change_reason: Pass/Fail framing may be treated as an enforceable compliance criterion for sludge disposal under Purpose A; the annual DMR reporting duty affects Purpose B; whether a missing or unreported Pass/Fail is no-data, not-required, or inadequate evidence changes Purpose C rows.

candidates.exact_span: Annual sludge production in dry metric tons/year.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Establishes a quantified annual reporting parameter whose applicability and monitoring period scope affect Purpose B; absent or incomplete reported values require Purpose C distinction between documented no-data states and missing required evidence.

candidates.exact_span: Amount of sludge disposed in a municipal solid waste landfill in dry metric tons/year.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Defines a disposal-amount reporting requirement tied to MSW landfill disposal that affects which monitoring obligations are in scope for Purpose B; interpretation of whether zero disposal, no discharge, or absent reporting satisfies or leaves unresolved the requirement affects Purpose C.

candidates.exact_span: Amount of sludge transported interstate in dry metric tons/year.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Creates a conditional reporting obligation that may apply only when interstate transport occurs; different readings of the trigger and required evidence change Purpose B applicability and Purpose C handling of missing transport/disposal data.

candidates.exact_span:
A certification that sewage sludge meets the requirements in 40 CFR 258 concerning the
          quality of the sludge disposed in a municipal solid waste landfill unit shall be attached to the
          DMR.
candidates.computation_change_reason: The 40 CFR 258 reference may invoke enforceable sludge quality limits relevant to compliance comparison under Purpose A; the certification attachment duty affects Purpose B monitoring obligations; whether a missing certification is unresolved, satisfied by other evidence, or a documented no-data state affects Purpose C.
